title: Anthropic's open-source framework for AI-powered vulnerability discovery
summary: Anthropic released an open-source framework called 'defending-code-reference-harness' for AI-powered vulnerability discovery in code. The project gained significant traction on Hacker News with 439 points and 123 comments, indicating strong community interest in AI-assisted security tools.
problem_solved: Automates the detection of security vulnerabilities in source code that would otherwise require manual expert review.
why_valuable: Enables developers and security teams to scale vulnerability auditing using AI, potentially catching critical security flaws earlier in the development lifecycle.
